speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether there are plans to look into the carrying capacity of our green and blue spaces and how trash can be better managed on our Southern Islands given that more Singaporeans have been visiting these nature parks.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: NParks is very mindful of the potential impact that increased visitorship may have on our biodiversity.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: In addition, there are signs around our nature areas and parks to educate visitors on park etiquette and regulations.

speaker: Mr Speaker
